description: Behavior after Pallium service restart or Claude Code session restart.

scenarios.name: pallium_restarts_before_inbox_delivery
scenarios.expected_recovery: dispatcher re-reads queued rows; inbox still registered and lease valid — re-deliver

scenarios.name: pallium_restarts_after_inbox_delivery_before_turn
scenarios.expected_recovery: within deadline: await admission turn; past deadline: fallback

scenarios.name: claude_code_session_restarts
scenarios.expected_recovery: inbox socket closes; capability lease expires; delivery falls back to natural-turn path

scenarios.name: already_admitted
scenarios.expected_recovery: delivery complete; no second inbox delivery
